source_claim: HoYoWiki's Honkai: Star Rail Lord Ravager entry lists Zephyro, Irontomb, and Phantylia among the named Lord Ravagers of the Antimatter Legion and describes Phantylia's in-game actions against the Xianzhou Luofu. This is a first-party game encyclopedia page identifying the named entities within Honkai: Star Rail.
notes: The source names these entities as members of Honkai: Star Rail's Lord Ravager group. Asat Pramad is separately established in HoYoverse's official version announcement. Unlisted canonical tags are omitted.
